name: copy-button
title: Copy button
description: A button that copies text and says so: the icon draws into a check, the label becomes Copied, a screen reader hears it, then it resets. It copes with a blocked clipboard.
docs: Pass a function as value for text worked out when the button is pressed; it may be async. Where the browser blocks the clipboard the text is selected and the button says to press Ctrl C. status shows a state without pressing.
